findings.result: All four exact native regulatory objects cite the 1985 homogeneous-hydratase study PMID3985968. The new 1983 combined-fraction assays are a different preparation/source. Its CuSO2 printed row cannot replace native CUSO4, and its zinc readouts cannot disprove the separate 1985 native inhibition assertion.

findings.result: ENZRXN-3364 explicitly cites the 1985 purified-native preparation. Its abstract supports reversible hydratase activity but does not resolve the exact substrate-isomer composition. The 1983 partial fraction and 2000 SYK-6 LigJ mixture do not prove that this historical ProH lacks formal E,E activity.

findings.result: The purified-native and heterologous-host evidence classes are correctly distinguished in ENZRXN-3365: PMID2229032 versus PMID11826967. The newly read 1990 source directly supports cleavage of both optical CHA forms, preferred negative-rotation form, metal dependence and separate alternate activities. It does not identify the older sample as NGJ1 or establish absolute R/S.
